messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is becoming a priority as fabrication approaches. There may be a cost impact if a change to the specified material is required. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication.

Sheet A-201 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner; we'll reconcile Sheet A-301 by addendum. There may be a cost impact if a change to the specified material is required. No schedule impact is expected.
